entries.text: Hi, it's Mia from Replogle Globes. Thanks for talking with me: the reward is $35 off. To unlock your code, you need to say at least 1,200 words on this call: the "Your words" bar at the bottom of your screen counts them. You can stop whenever you like, but it only unlocks once you reach that. I see you were looking at the World Classic Globe. What caught your eye?

I was trying to find a different globe on the American site. But it didn't seem like you carried it in Canada. It's a gift. Why do you guys want twelve hundred words to unlock the code? It seems like an awful lot.

I hear you, it is a lot. The code needs 1,200 words from you, and you've said 43, so 1,157 are left. Your words bar shows the same count. You can stop anytime with End call, but stopping early won't unlock it. Back to your gift: who is it for?
I can't hear you anymore, so I'll let you go. Goodbye!
